resources.string: CleanFrame TV
CleanFrame TV Home compatibility

When enabled in CleanFrame, opens CleanFrame when the Google TV home screen appears. Reads only Google TV window names, never screen contents or key presses. Keeps Google TV installed and enabled. Turn it off here to stop.
Home button on Google TV

If Home keeps opening Google TV, try compatibility mode. Keep the Google TV launcher enabled. This mode opens CleanFrame when Google TV Home appears, including when returning from an app. It uses only Google TV window names; it cannot read screen contents.

CleanFrame TV remote buttons

Opens the app you assigned when you press a remote button such as the Netflix or Mi key. It only acts on the buttons you assign; every other key press passes through unchanged and nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
